event.title: Tabletop RPGs for Adults
event.description: Join local GM Matt as he runs a variety of Tabletop Role Playing Games that rotate each month. No experience in any system is required and anyone interested in dipping their toes into the TTRPG world are welcomed and encouraged to join in on the fun! This month's game is: Daggerheart The town of Cadence is one steeped in superstition. It was built over a century ago when a large copper mine was established nearby promising wealth and prosperity. However, the mine was located within the soft grounds of a swamp leading to poor living conditions for the miners on shift, frequent cave-ins, hazardous gasses, and a variety of other fatal accidents. Disregarding the cries from the public to shut the mine down the owner of the copper mine, Liviett Truce kept her operation going for nearly 30 years with little care of her employed miners. One day rumors of a creature stalking the mining camps in the swamp made their way back to Cadence. Miners would go missing, claw marks raked through the canvas of their tents, trails of blood leading out into the murky waters of the swamp. The town erupted in a panic and the workers left the camps on strike. Liviett wanted to put an end to the strike swiftly and as frugally as possible so she decided to go visit the now emptied mining camps to prove no such creature exists. Liviett Truce never returned and the mine was abandoned. Today, 85 years later, rumors of a creature in the swamp making people disappear have begun circulating again within the streets of Cadence. A large sum of gold has been offered on local bulletins to anyone who can procure the head of this creature or proof of its non-existence. The bulletin is sponsored by Cosdum Truce, grandson of Liviett. Registration is required. This group is for adults only.

event.description: 🌿 BEAUTY OR BANE? THE SECRET LIFE OF YOUR GARDEN 💀 Vibrant lavender and mauve blossoms sway in the breeze while butterflies dip and dance above. event.description: Swoon Squad is a romance-centered book club with a twist. Instead of everyone reading the same assigned title, we choose a monthly trope and invite you to pick any book that fits the theme!
